tasks.title: Implement Librarian Book Management
tasks.description: Develop functionality for librarians to add and update book-copy records and record the return of borrowed copies.

tasks.title: Implement Member Browsing and Loan Access
tasks.description: Develop functionality for browsing available copies and securing member loan access, including sign-in controls and multi-loan restrictions.

tasks.title: Implement Loan and Availability Logic
tasks.description: Develop backend logic to prevent duplicate active loans and update availability status upon return.

tasks.title: Implement Localization
tasks.description: Configure the web application to support English as the primary language.

acceptance_criteria.when: the librarian adds or updates a book-copy record
acceptance_criteria.then: the system updates the repository with the new or modified copy details

acceptance_criteria.given: a member is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: the member accesses the browse available copies page
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays the list of available copies

acceptance_criteria.given: a member is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: the member attempts to borrow a copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system denies the request and prompts for sign-in

acceptance_criteria.given: a member is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: the member attempts to view their current loans
acceptance_criteria.then: the system denies the request and prompts for sign-in

acceptance_criteria.when: the member views their loan list
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays only the records associated with that member ID

acceptance_criteria.when: the member attempts to borrow an additional copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system prevents the creation of a fourth loan

acceptance_criteria.when: the member attempts to borrow a fourth copy

acceptance_criteria.given: a specific book copy has an existing active loan
acceptance_criteria.when: a member attempts to borrow that specific unavailable copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system refuses the borrowing request

acceptance_criteria.when: the librarian records the return of a borrowed copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system marks the loan as returned

acceptance_criteria.given: a book copy is already assigned to an active loan
acceptance_criteria.when: another member attempts to borrow that same copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the borrowing request to prevent a second active loan

acceptance_criteria.given: a borrowed copy has been returned
acceptance_criteria.then: the system updates the copy status to available

acceptance_criteria.when: a signed-in member selects to borrow that copy
acceptance_criteria.then: a new loan record is created for the member

open_questions.question: Are there specific performance benchmarks required for the application beyond the language constraint?
